reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: POST handler is a public exported Next.js route — public API exception applies. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is the unauthenticated public HTTP endpoint POST /oauth/token. Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via POST /oauth/token by submitting two concurrent requests with the same valid authorization code and code_verifier; both calls reach get_authorization_code (L71) before either triggers delete_authorization_code (L151-152), causing both to receive distinct valid access tokens from a single-use code — violating the OAuth 2.0 single-use guarantee. Additionally, on client-mismatch (L83-88), redirect-URI mismatch (L90-95), PKCE failure (L116-120), and user-not-found (L130-135) exit paths the code is never deleted, leaving it replayable for subsequent requests.
